description:
## Objective

Restore Flow form equivalence, concurrent input isolation, and cleanup checks.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U6`
Covers: `R1, R2, R6; KTD1, KTD2, KTD4, KTD8.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.5 (U5) — Port Action and Flow property checks must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.11 (U11) — Port advanced Action examples must be complete; jido-07x.13 (U13) — Port core runtime and topology examples must be complete; jido-07x.16 (U16) — Port core property, system, and peer checks must be complete.

## Files

Read `../refs/jido_action/test/system/**` and `../refs/jido_action/test/load/**` at Action commit `40ec1f0af3a373bae5e6d869017cc229c85aef92`. Add `test/system/runtime/action_flow/**` and `test/load/action_flow/**`. Change the manifest.

## Instructions

1. Port the Flow module, compiled program, and Instruction equivalence test.
2. Port the fixed 200-workflow isolation check.
3. Port the fresh-VM burn-in command.
4. Assert cleanup and result ownership. Do not use elapsed time as a pass condition.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All three Flow forms return the same required result.
- [ ] Every load result keeps its own input.
- [ ] No task or managed execution process remains after the run.

## Verification

- `mix test.system test/system/runtime/action_flow` and `mix test.load test/load/action_flow` exit with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.
title: Port Action system and load checks
